**NSXL for Windows 1.1.0**: quick menu over games, Xbox mode, Spotify, controller pairing and a VPN switch.

### Download
- **`NSXL-Setup-1.1.0.exe`** installs over earlier versions and keeps your settings.
- **`NSXL-Portable-1.1.0.exe`** runs without installing.

Windows may show a SmartScreen warning because NSXL isn't code-signed. Choose **More info › Run anyway**.

### New
- **Quick menu over your games.** Press **View + Menu** together on an Xbox controller, or **Ctrl+Alt+Space** on a keyboard. It has the same cards as on Android:
  - **Home:** go to NSXL Home, or take a screenshot. Screenshots are saved to Pictures › Screenshots and show in your Album under the game.
  - **Switch Game** and **Music**, with what's playing, play/pause and skip.
  - **Sound:** PC volume and mute. **Brightness:** laptops and handhelds.
  - **Accessories** and **Network**, including the VPN switch.
  - **Power:** close the game (press A twice), or sleep.
  - You can switch the button to the Xbox button in **Settings › Controls › Quick menu button**. If you do, turn off "Open Xbox Game Bar using this button" in Windows settings.
- **Xbox mode home app.** In **Settings › System › Xbox mode home app**, choose **Set up**, and approve the Windows permission prompt. Then pick **NSXL** in Windows **Settings › Gaming › Full screen experience** (also called Xbox mode) under **Choose home app**, and turn on starting in that mode. Your PC then starts straight into NSXL. This needs Windows 11 24H2 or later on a PC where Xbox mode is available.
- **Music.** The Music button opens NSXL's own player: album art, progress, play/pause, skip, shuffle, repeat, volume, choosing which device plays, and your Spotify playlists including Liked Songs. Connect it in **Settings › Music**:
  1. Create a free app at developer.spotify.com.
  2. Add the redirect URI shown in NSXL.
  3. Paste in the app's Client ID and choose **Connect**.
  - Controlling playback this way needs Spotify Premium. Without an account, play/pause and skip still work for Spotify or any other player.
- **Pair controllers in NSXL.** The Controllers page now turns Bluetooth on, searches for nearby controllers, and pairs or forgets them, without opening Windows settings. It also lists connected controllers, and can make one buzz so you can tell which is which.
- **VPN (Private Internet Access).** **Settings › VPN** turns your PIA VPN on and off, shows its status and VPN IP address, lets you choose a region, and can connect when NSXL starts. It's also in the quick menu under Network. You need the PIA app installed and signed in.

### Good to know
- The quick menu shows over games running in borderless or windowed mode. Games in exclusive full screen may hide it.
- The quick menu's controller button reads Xbox (XInput) controllers. PlayStation and other controllers work when Steam Input or similar presents them as Xbox controllers; the keyboard shortcut always works.
